title: Design System: Glossy Gems by Zee

page-title.purpose: h1 on page heads, product, checkout and confirmation screens.

headline.purpose: Section h2; one phrase may turn italic at weight 400.

title.purpose: Set names, category names, legends, panel headings.

note.purpose: Italic serif for a person’s words: gift notes, the footer tagline.

lede.purpose: The paragraph under a headline, max 28 to 30em.

body.purpose: Default text; 1rem on phones and in the dashboard. Tabular numerals.

item-name.purpose: Product names on cards; 500 is the emphasis weight.

meta.purpose: Types, counts, hints, breadcrumbs, row sub-lines.

label.purpose: Uppercase group headings: footer columns, filter rail, table heads. Never a kicker.

data.purpose: Order references and account numbers, in the text face so every character reads.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Toast and the opened mobile menu (--shadow).

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Bag drawer over a plum-950 backdrop at 50%.

shadows.name: seal
shadows.purpose: Gold sale seal over the hero portrait.

shadows.name: save-bar
shadows.purpose: Sticky save bar in the dashboard.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Orchid halo on focused inputs, with a plum border.

motion.name: out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve (--out): every transition and entrance.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Buttons, chips, fields, nav and hover fills.

motion.name: image
motion.purpose: Image scale on card hover, ring lift.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Hero rings and seal fade in from 94% scale.

motion.name: orbit
motion.purpose: Gold dust circling the hero portrait.

motion.name: bump
motion.purpose: Count badge when the bag or saved count changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion switches all animation and transition off.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on paper, blush and white grounds.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, white field with a field-line border, hint below.
components.html: As it should appear on the parcel.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--sans, 'Jost', 'Century Gothic', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #2a0f2e); max-width: 360px; } .ds-field label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #cfaed3; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; font: inherit; color: inherit; transition: border-color .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #7a5e7e; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--plum, #690365); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: var(--plum, #690365); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(174 0 147 / 0.18); } .ds-field-hint { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #6d4d72); font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Toggle filters with a count; selected fills plum.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #cfaed3; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #2a0f2e); font-family: var(--sans, 'Jost', 'Century Gothic', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip span { margin-left: 4px; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--plum, #690365); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--plum, #690365); background: var(--plum, #690365); color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orchid, #ae0093); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { width: 240px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Jost', 'Century Gothic', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #2a0f2e); } .ds-card-media { overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius, 18px); background: var(--blush, #fdeeff); aspect-ratio: 1; } .ds-card-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 40% 35%, #f5cc7e 0%, #d9b98c 45%, #b89a78 100%); transition: scale .8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-img { scale: 1.05; } .ds-card-type { margin: 16px 4px 0; color: var(--muted, #6d4d72); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-card-name { margin: 0 4px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin: 8px 4px 0; min-height: 44px; } .ds-card-price { font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-add { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--plum, #690365); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card-add:hover { background: var(--orchid, #ae0093); transform: scale(1.08); } .ds-card-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orchid, #ae0093); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: The Ring
components.description: Signature frame for people and groupings: a 1.5px gold line with a padded gap around a circular photo, with a small ring overlapping.
components.css: .ds-ring-field { padding: 32px; border-radius: 24px; background: radial-gradient(90% 120% at 100% 0%, #ae0093 0%, transparent 60%), var(--plum-900, #2c0a31); } .ds-ring-art { position: relative; width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 1; margin-inline: auto; } .ds-ring { display: block; padding: 9px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ring, #f5cc7e); border-radius: 50%; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-ring-lg { position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 14px; border-width: 2px; } .ds-ring-sm { position: absolute; left: -7%; bottom: -3%; width: 36%; padding: 7px; background: var(--plum-900, #2c0a31); } .ds-ring-photo { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(70% 70% at 40% 30%, #c98d5e 0%, #7a4a2c 55%, #3c2416 100%); } .ds-ring-photo-b { background: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 45%, #fff6e6 0%, #d9c3a0 60%, #b79f7c 100%); } .ds-ring-art:hover .ds-ring-lg { transform: translateY(-6px); }

narrative.overview:
A glossy magazine in Zee's own colours. The store takes its palette from her logo and flyer (deep plum, orchid, flyer pink, gold, charcoal) and its one recurring figure from the logo too: a thin gold ring with a photograph seated inside it. Satin plum fields own whole regions of the home page; the commerce pages work on a near-white paper so warm product photographs and forms have a quiet ground. Bodoni Moda carries the headlines with an italic turn on the phrase that matters, and Jost carries everything else.

The owner dashboard lives in the same world, turned down: a pale lilac ground, a flat plum side rail, white panels with hairline borders, and gold reserved for the section you are in. It reuses the storefront's buttons, fields, pills and tokens and adds no identity of its own.

The system refuses the cream-and-beige minimal luxury store. Colour is saturated and owned; surfaces are flat; depth is saved for things that float.
keyCharacteristics: Whole bands of colour (satin plum, flyer pink, blush) instead of boxed cards on one ground.
Gold ring lines framing portraits and groupings; single pieces stay full squares.
High-contrast Bodoni display with an italic emphasis phrase, set against geometric Jost.
Pill and circle controls; softly cornered fields and media.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; shadow only on floating layers.
Slow, settled motion on one exponential ease-out curve.

rules.name: The Owned Field Rule
rules.body: Dark and pink are regions, not accents: a section is wholly satin plum, wholly pink, wholly blush or wholly paper, edge to edge. The satin field is plum-900 with an orchid radial bloom from one corner (plus plum-glow from the opposite corner and a faint 118deg pink sheen on the large bands).

rules.name: The Gold on Dark Rule
rules.body: Full-strength gold fills and gold text appear only on plum or charcoal. On light grounds gold exists only as the deep ring hairline. The single exception in the build is the no-JavaScript notice bar.

rules.name: The Paper for Commerce Rule
rules.body: Shop, product, gift builder, bag, checkout and help work on paper with blush support. Dark fields there are limited to one contained box (gift box, bank details).

rules.name: The Italic Turn Rule
rules.body: A serif headline may turn one phrase to italic at weight 400 ("Jewelry worth *dressing up for.*"). One turn per headline, on the phrase that carries the meaning; on the hero it also takes flyer pink.

rules.name: The Data in Sans Rule
rules.body: Anything a person will copy or read aloud character by character (order reference, account number, phone, price) is set in Jost with tabular numerals, even where it occupies a heading slot. Bodoni's hairlines are for words.

rules.name: The Label Is a Heading Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked label names a group of links, filters or columns. It is never placed above a headline as a kicker.

rules.name: The Only Floats Cast Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element is detached from the page and sits above it (drawer, toast, menu, seal, sticky bar). Shadows are large, soft and pulled in with negative spread. Nothing in the page flow casts one.

rules.name: The Ring Rule
rules.body: The gold ring frames people and groupings: the portrait, a category, the members of a set, an editorial accent, the items gathered in a gift. The image a shopper buys from (product card, product page, gift option, bag line) is always a full square with soft corners, so no part of a piece is cropped.

dos: Do give each section one field colour edge to edge, and change field to change subject.
Do put people and groupings in gold rings, and overlap a small ring onto its neighbour.
Do keep the image a shopper buys from a full square with 18px corners.
Do use the gold button for the main action on a dark field and the plum button on a light one.
Do make controls pills or circles and give fields 12px corners.
Do separate with hairlines and field changes; keep shadows for the drawer, toast, menu, seal and sticky bar.
Do set order references, account numbers and prices in Jost with tabular numerals.
Do say status in words inside a tinted pill.
Do turn one phrase of a serif headline to italic 400.
Do build dashboard screens from the storefront's own buttons, fields and tokens on the lilac ground.
donts: Don't drift toward cream or beige neutrals; every working neutral here is tinted plum.
Don't put full-strength gold fills or gold text on paper, blush or pink; use the deep ring hairline there.
Don't crop a product's own card or detail image into a circle.
Don't wrap product cards in a bordered or shadowed box.
Don't set body copy, labels, prices or references in Bodoni Moda.
Don't place the uppercase tracked label above a headline as a kicker; it names groups of links, filters and columns only.
Don't use the satin gradient for the dashboard's working area; it belongs to the storefront bands and the sign-in side.
Don't show order or stock state by colour alone.
Don't add a second easing curve or bouncy motion.
